faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about services, workflow, and how to get in touch.

q1.q: Do you take small freelance projects or only large systems?
q1.a: I handle a wide range of projects, from automation bots and trading tools to management systems. The focus is always on pragmatic solutions that deliver real value.

q2.q: How can I contact you directly for a consultation?
q2.a: You can chat with the AI assistant for an initial estimate, or click the 'Contact Admin' button to reach me directly via Zalo, Telegram, or Phone.

q3.q: What is the quoting process for an AI project?
q3.a: You can use our online AI chatbot directly on this site to get an instant estimated quote based on your technical requirements and project scale.

q4.q: Can I pay in installments or split the payment into stages?
q4.a: Absolutely. I support splitting payments based on project milestones, allowing you to manage your budget easily and ensure quality at every step.

q5.q: Do you offer a demo before formalizing the project?
q5.a: Yes. For complex projects, I can develop a Demo/PoC (Proof of Concept) with a small deposit, helping you verify the solution's effectiveness before committing to the full scope.
